The or iginal hard copy of the Integrity Pact shall be sent to the Chief Administrative Officer, All India Institute of S peech and Hearing, Mysuru – 570006 and must reach within 07 days from the date of bid opening. Integrity Pact agreement is a mandatory document. Bidders must upload the duly signed IP agreement in t he GeM portal and also submit the hard copy to this office. The format of the IP agreement cannot be altere d or modified by the bidders; however, they may include essential details such as the title of the bid, GeM B id No., etc. Any other deviation or non-compliance identified by this office will result in summary rejection o f the bid. 2.Further, if any doubts / clarifications: email: aiish.pur@aiishmysore.in, 0821-2502133/2134. [OR] 0821-25 02111. 3.All bidders should enclose the quotation for items required to be supplied on daily b asis in the Canteen at AIISH, Mysore is to be submitted at the time of Financial biddin g only. In case, if you revealed the quote during technical evaluation, the bidder shall be summarily rejected. Further, all terms and conditions have been mentioned in the scope of work/ATC. Bidders are requested to go through the same for any clarification. Bidders should upload the following documents with company seal and signature: 1. Currently valid license for running canteen like activities in Karnataka. 2. Currently valid FSSAI Registration Certificate 3. Proof of having executed at least 3 annual contracts in Central/State Gover nment Departments/ Autonomous / PSUs/ reputed private institutions durin g the last five years. Out of these, one annual contract in any of the cantee ns attached to Central/State Government Departments/ Autonomous / PSUs . (Work completion certificate for proof of experience should cover the detai ls of works of similar nature, and duration carried out. Work orders will n ot be accepted as proof of experience.) 4. Annual turnover for the past three years certified by Chartered Accountant. 5. Supporting documents in case of claiming MSME/ NSIC exemption (as appli cable) 6. Undertaking for no case is pending/registered in the police records against the Proprietor/partners or the Company (Agency).
